question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a orange present, Claire has a pink present, Dave has a white present, Eve has a green present, Fred has a brown present, and Gertrude has a gold present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) orange present
(C) pink present
(D) white present
(E) green present
(F) brown present
(G) gold present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (black, orange, pink, white, green, brown, gold)
1. Eve swaps with Bob: (black, green, pink, white, orange, brown, gold)
2. Dave swaps with Fred: (black, green, pink, brown, orange, white, gold)
3. Gertrude swaps with Claire: (black, green, gold, brown, orange, white, pink)
4. Alice swaps with Gertrude: (pink, green, gold, brown, orange, white, black)
5. Eve swaps with Claire: (pink, green, orange, brown, gold, white, black)
6. Eve swaps with Dave: (pink, green, orange, gold, brown, white, black)
7. Fred swaps with Alice: (white, green, orange, gold, brown, pink, black)
Bob has the green present, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
